audit_method: Dependency-order source read for selected training surfaces.
Python AST parse for Python files where applicable.
Keyword scan for credential/logits/readiness/external dependency boundaries.
Manual high-risk outline review for train loop, BitLinear/MoE/Liquid, distillation, telemetry, kernels, final closure sync.
audit_scope: Canonical 45K training/eval/orchestration/SDK/config/tokenizer/test surfaces plus direct closure scripts.
claim_boundary: No training/model capability claim is introduced by this audit. No teacher/tokenizer/dataset policy, prompt surface, or model architecture change was made.

finding_policy.EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY: Needs real run, hardware, credentials, dataset, or downloaded artifacts.
finding_policy.FIX_NOW: Concrete bug affecting training correctness, artifact integrity, secret safety, checkpoint/eval/reproducibility.
finding_policy.NO_TOUCH: Correct as-is for closure scope; no code edit.
finding_policy.PHASE2: Improvement or adjacent legacy surface not required for 45K closure.

generated_for: MertFormer Build30 logger hardening closure pass
